event_description: User successfully authenticates with email and password.
User login attempt fails due to incorrect credentials.
A new user account is successfully created during the registration flow.
User chooses to start a free trial during registration.
User selects a payment method (credit card or PIX) on the subscription page.
Credit card payment for subscription is successfully confirmed.
PIX payment for subscription is confirmed by the payment gateway.
A new accommodation reservation is successfully created.
A financial revenue entry is registered in the system.
A financial expense is registered in the system.
User requests a password reset email.
The onboarding tour is shown for the first time or resumed.
An onboarding tour step is displayed to the user.
The user successfully completes an onboarding tour step.
The user leaves the onboarding tour before completing it.
The user's first report contains at least one real reservation for a non-demo accommodation.
The 70% three-month subscription offer is displayed.
